== Hero Usage ==
* [[Hero]]es use this skill while in combat as soon as there is a dead party member in range. They do not reserve its usage for resurrecting multiple party members.

== Notes ==
* This skill, [[Eternal Aura]], [["By Ural's Hammer!"]], and [[Unyielding Aura]] are the fastest resurrection skills.
* [["Never Surrender!"]] and [["Never Give Up!"]] are useful follow-up skills, since they share the same attribute and have a low energy cost.
{{bug|"We Shall Return!" does not return energy from [[Leadership]].}}

== Trivia ==

* During World War II, [[w:Douglas MacArthur|Douglas MacArthur]] infamously said, ''"I came out of Bataan and I shall return"'' and refused requests to rephrase this (in his speeches) to, ''"We shall return"''.
